text:
# Close wrap, Tue 2026-11-10 (~4:20 PM ET)

**Indexes:** Dow −0.30% to 52,231.89; S&P ~−0.4%, Nasdaq ~−0.7% (pared from −0.9%/−1.6% at midday) after Oct CPI ran hot: headline +0.4% m/m vs 0.3%, core +0.3% vs 0.2%, third straight 0.3% core. 10-yr back above 5%; Waller floated 50bp in Dec, Logan wants two more hikes ([Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-tuesday-november-10-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-inflation-data-cpi-090627830.html); [StockTitan](https://www.stocktitan.net/articles/stock-market-today-live-november-10-2026); [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/09/stock-market-today-live-updates.html)). Nine of 11 sectors red early; energy the main gainer as Brent slid below $90; utilities/real estate lagged ([Reuters](https://reuters.com/business/sp-500-dow-futures-climb-oil-slide-lifts-sentiment-2026-11-10/?outputType=chromeless)).

**Covered names:** NVDA −5.47% to $168.89 (board hired Wachtell/Joon Kim for the Huang probe); chips mixed. MSFT −3% on Anthropic's Claude workplace tools. Avoids confirmed: HIMS ~−18%, ONON ~−8%, SKYD −9%. AAON ~+19%, ZIP ~+51%, AMRC ~+19% on beats ([StockTitan](https://www.stocktitan.net/articles/stock-market-today-live-november-10-2026)).

**After hours:** CRWV Q3 rev $3.66B vs $3.55B est., adj op income $379M, FY26 rev guide raised to $13.0–13.3B, backlog $132.5B; Q4 interest expense $1.05–1.15B ([CoreWeave](https://investors.coreweave.com/news/news-details/2026/CoreWeave-Reports-Strong-Third-Quarter-2026-Results/default.aspx); [Reuters](https://www.reuters.com/business/coreweave-beats-quarterly-revenue-estimates-ai-demand-defies-growing-doubts-2026-11-10/)). RGTI also AMC.

**Tomorrow:** Veterans Day, stocks open, bonds closed. Thu: NBIS BMO, AMAT/CSCO AMC, jobless claims; Fri: PPI.

**Ideas (swing, long-only):** No new calls. Hot CPI + 10-yr >5% is a rate shock for growth/small caps, and today's big gappers are either AI-infra (group avoid extended to 11/13) or >10% close gaps that lost hard last week (CDW/RVTY lesson).
- HUM: carried hold, med. Beat-and-raise; risk MA cost trend. Not re-logged.
